title: Specification of certificate split search
statement: Let $C,c,m,n$ be natural numbers. The bounded certificate split search at length $m$ returns $n$ if and only if $n+(C+1)(n+1)^c=m$.
replaced:
For $C, c, m \in \mathbb{N}$ let $\mathrm{split}_{C,c}(m)$ be the least
$n \le m$ with $n + (C+1)(n+1)^c = m$, and undefined if there is none. Then for
all $C, c, m, n \in \mathbb{N}$, $\mathrm{split}_{C,c}(m) = n$ if and only if
$n + (C+1)(n+1)^c = m$.
